about: Log 412 held-out set, written 2026-10-12 before any run of it. Gold follows scripts/capability_sheet.yaml. CS: a condition in another sentence makes the asked result unsupported (single cells, layers from different samples, spatial neighbours, dynamics, overlapping groups); CK: the same as a follow-up turn (--resume); CP: a condition is stated that does not rule the result out (pseudo-bulk, same samples, one group, compared time points, bulk biopsies); XP, XN: plain controls.

items.prompt: We have expression, motifs and PPI for 64 profiles. Each profile is one cell from a Smart-seq3 plate. We want a TF-gene network for each profile.

requirements.words: We want a TF-gene network for each profile

items.prompt: We have expression for 3,000 profiles. All of them are single nuclei from one brain. We want a co-expression network per profile.

requirements.words: We want a co-expression network per profile

items.prompt: We have proteomics for 50 patients and RNA-seq for a different set of 60 patients. We want a partial-correlation network linking proteins and transcripts.

requirements.words: a partial-correlation network linking proteins and transcripts

items.prompt: We have methylation and expression data. The two were collected from different cohorts. We want one network that links CpGs to genes by partial correlation.

requirements.words: one network that links CpGs to genes by partial correlation

items.prompt: We have Visium data for 4,000 spots with motifs and PPI. Each spot's network has to take its neighbouring spots into account. We want TF-gene networks per spot.

requirements.words: We want TF-gene networks per spot

items.prompt: We have expression at 8 time points, with motifs and PPI. The model must describe how each time point's regulation leads to the next. We want a TF-gene network.

requirements.words: We want a TF-gene network

items.prompt: We have a bipartite TF-gene network. Each TF may belong to several modules at once. We want its modules.

requirements.words: We want its modules

items.prompt: We have somatic mutations for 150 tumors. A patient may belong to more than one subtype. We want subtypes from pathway mutation scores.

requirements.words: We want subtypes from pathway mutation scores
